# Load libaries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

loki2015 <- read.csv("C:/Users/patri/python_workspace/copepods-lipid-content/prediction_outputs/model_resnet34_prosomeLOKI2015/new_predictions_loki2015_20250000.csv")
```

# Compare IoUs
```{r}
plot_grid(
    ggplot(loki2015, aes(x = prosome_pixels_annotated, 
                       y = lipid_pixels_annotated)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
    
  ggplot(loki2015, aes(x = prosome_pixels_annotated, 
                       y = IoU_prosome)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange"), 
  
  
  ggplot(loki2015, aes(x = lipid_pixels_annotated, 
                       y = IoU_lipid1)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ylab("IoU lipid (no prosome crop)") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange"), 
  
  
  ggplot(loki2015, aes(x = lipid_pixels_annotated, 
                       y = IoU_lipid2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ylab("IoU lipid (with prosome crop)") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange"),
  
   ggplot(loki2015, aes(x = prosome_pixels_annotated, 
                       y = lipidfullness_annotated)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  
   ggplot(loki2015, aes(x = lipidfullness_annotated, 
                       y = lipidfullness_predicted2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth() +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  nrow = 3
)

ggsave("figures/loki2015_300imgs_results.png",
       width = 7, height = 10, units = "in")
```

## Average result summary
```{r}
loki2015.long <- loki2015 %>% 
  select(filename, IoU_prosome:F1score_lipid2) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = IoU_prosome:F1score_lipid2,
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>% 
  separate(metric, c("metric","model"),sep="_", fill = "left") %>% 
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("IoU","Recall","F1score"))) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("prosome","lipid1","lipid2"))) 
  
summary <- loki2015.long %>% 
  group_by(model, metric) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

write.csv(summary, file = "loki2015_300images_model_performance.csv")
```
